meals.name: Breakfast burrito with eggs, black beans & cheese
meals.ingredients: large flour tortilla 1, eggs 2, black beans 100g, cheddar 30g, salsa 2 tbsp, avocado ¼, pepper and onion sauté (makes 6, freeze)
meals.attribution: standard freezer recovery burrito (incredibleegg.org spicy black bean breakfast burrito; danawhitenutrition.com recovery burrito); r/Ultramarathon tracked-day breakfast wrap

meals.name: Egg & cheese English muffin
meals.ingredients: wholewheat English muffin 1, eggs 2, cheddar 30g, spinach, tomato slice
meals.attribution: standard vegetarian endurance-athlete breakfast sandwich (220triathlon.com vegetarian triathlete guide; therunningchannel.com)

meals.name: Chimichurri steak & eggs
meals.ingredients: skirt steak 150g, eggs 2 fried, chimichurri (parsley, garlic, olive oil, vinegar) 2 tbsp, lettuce leaves or grain-free wrap
meals.attribution: Chimichurri Steak Breakfast Burrito, The Paleo Diet athlete recipes (https://thepaleodiet.com/recipes/paleo-recipes-for-athletes/)

meals.name: Sweet potato & sausage skillet
meals.ingredients: sweet potato 250g diced, breakfast sausage (GF, no fillers) 120g, red pepper ½, onion ½, olive oil 1 tbsp, paprika (makes 3)
meals.attribution: The Pretty Bee top-9-allergen-free meal plan, Day 7; commonly reported paleo athlete weekend breakfast (r/paleo)

meals.name: Ground beef & sweet potato hash
meals.ingredients: lean ground beef 300g, sweet potato 300g diced, onion 1, red pepper 1, paprika, olive oil 1 tbsp (makes 3)
meals.attribution: standard paleo/Whole30-style breakfast hash, widely reported in endurance-athlete real-food rotations (Feed Zone-adjacent); commonly reported

meals.name: Tamagoyaki, rice & miso soup
meals.ingredients: eggs 3, kombu dashi 2 tbsp, tamari 1 tsp, sugar 1 tsp, cooked rice 200g, miso soup (miso 1 tbsp, kombu dashi 250ml, tofu 50g, wakame)
meals.attribution: the standard Japanese breakfast set — rice, protein, soup (https://www.justonecookbook.com/traditional-japanese-breakfast-at-home/); commonly reported

cachedPages.title: Traditional Japanese Breakfast and How To Make It At Home

meals.name: Congee with shredded chicken & scallion
meals.ingredients: white rice 80g dry, chicken stock 800ml, cooked shredded chicken 100g, ginger, scallion, tamari 1 tsp, white pepper (makes 3)
meals.attribution: classic Chinese breakfast and convalescence food (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Congee); commonly reported gentle recovery meal among East Asian endurance athletes

meals.name: Kedgeree
meals.ingredients: basmati rice 100g dry, smoked or poached salmon 120g, hard-boiled eggs 2, curry powder 1 tsp, onion ½, olive oil 1 tbsp, rocket 30g, lemon (makes 2)
meals.attribution: trigirl.co.uk GF/DF triathlete recovery-meal list ("kedgeree, made with rice, salmon, hard-boiled egg and rocket")

meals.name: Chilaquiles verdes with egg
meals.ingredients: corn tortilla chips 80g, salsa verde 200ml, fried egg 1, queso fresco 30g, black beans 100g, onion, coriander (salsa makes 4)
meals.attribution: everyday Mexican breakfast, popular weekend rest-day choice in athlete food-culture round-ups; commonly reported

meals.name: Tofu & black bean breakfast burrito
meals.ingredients: corn tortillas 2 large, firm tofu 150g scrambled with turmeric, black beans 100g, avocado ¼, salsa 2 tbsp, coriander (makes 6, freeze)
meals.attribution: 220triathlon.com vegan recipe round-up (breakfast tacos with marinated tofu, beans and avocado); standard vegan adaptation of the athlete recovery burrito

meals.name: Tofu scramble with roasted potatoes
meals.ingredients: firm tofu 200g, turmeric ½ tsp, nutritional yeast 1 tbsp, red pepper ½, spinach 1 cup, potatoes 250g roasted, olive oil 1 tbsp, black salt
meals.attribution: Forks Over Knives tofu veggie scramble with roasted potatoes (https://www.forksoverknives.com/); the standard egg-free breakfast protein swap

meals.name: Chickpea flour scramble with spinach & tomato
meals.ingredients: chickpea (besan) flour 100g, water 150ml, nutritional yeast 1 tbsp, turmeric, black salt, tomato 1 diced, spinach 1 cup, olive oil 1 tbsp
meals.attribution: standard vegan chickpea-flour omelette technique, cross-referenced in soy-free vegan protein guides (Nadura Foods; Vegan Richa-style); commonly reported

meals.name: Muffin, banana & coffee
meals.ingredients: bran or oat muffin 1, banana 1, coffee, Greek yogurt pot 150g

meals.name: Smoked salmon, avocado & spinach plate
meals.ingredients: smoked salmon 100g, avocado 1, baby spinach 2 cups, cucumber ½, olive oil 1 tbsp, lemon, capers
meals.attribution: commonly reported low-carb rest-day breakfast pattern (Racing Weight-style lean-day guidance); Zach Bitter's bacon, eggs and spinach recovery-day breakfast (https://www.mensjournal.com/health-fitness/zach-bitter-100-mile-american-record-holder-he-also-eats-almost-no-carbs)
